spec.name: Furniture Mummy Sarcophagus
spec.description: An upright open sarcophagus with a stepped crown, gold and deep teal striped framing, and a peaceful linen mummy with dark eyes and folded crossed arms. A shallow integral plinth supports the entire connected structure. Front faces negative Z; all geometry is axis-aligned.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: upright open Egyptian sarcophagus with gold and deep teal striped trim framing a cream linen-wrapped mummy with two dark eyes and crossed arms; shallow supported base, no gore. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
